</div><div id="cc-m-6110926418" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-6110926418">Amansinaya Glamping</h1></div><div id="cc-m-6110926518" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 50px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-6204508718" class="j-module n j-imageSubtitle "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-3">
<img id="cc-m-imagesubtitle-image-6204508718" src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/none/path/s3cfe8bfb422b28e3/image/i74e58e8fd6a68a26/version/1670818259/image.jpg" alt="" class="" data-src-width="890" data-src-height="309" data-src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/none/path/s3cfe8bfb422b28e3/image/i74e58e8fd6a68a26/version/1670818259/image.jpg" data-image-id="4098580818"/>    

</figure>

<div class="cc-clear"></div>
<script id="cc-m-reg-6204508718"></script></div><div id="cc-m-6110926718" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 20px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-6193618718" class="j-module n j-text "><h2 style="text-align: center;">
    <span style="color: #ff0000;">Barefoot luxury and hammock lifestyle</span>
</h2>

<p style="text-align: left;">
    The Amansinaya Resort has  5 bungalows and 6 luxury furnished glampingpods, as well as a dorm, hammockspace and treetents for the low budget travelers. 
</p>

<p style="text-align: left;">
    We grow a lot of our food or get it from the farms nearby and get the locals involved to help us with the camp. The Mangyan villages are our neighbours and they are happy to give you an insight
    into their everyday life too.
</p>

<p style="text-align: left;">
    Each bungalow has a nice view of the ocean. The open air washroom gives you a novel experience: shower under the stars! <strong><em><br/></em></strong>
</p>

<p style="text-align: left;">
    All meals are included in the roomprices. Accomodation comes with breakfast, lunch and dinner. Breakfast and lunch are a buffet and dinners are set menu consisting of soup/salad, maindish and
    desert. Of course and vegan/vegetarians options are available.
</p></div><div id="cc-m-6193629518" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 20px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7206894718" class="j-module n j-hgrid ">    <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column" style="width: 49%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-1814662318"><div id="cc-m-7206901418" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7206901418">Bungalows</h1></div><div id="cc-m-6880784018" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
     
</p>

<p>
    Enjoy the beauty of the ocean and the beach from your terrace. You can jump from your bed on your board. All bungalows have an outdoor private bathroom and toilets.
</p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">
     
</p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">
    Price per night: single occupation: 75 Euro per person, double occupation: 50 Euro per person
</p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">
    included: Breakfastbuffet, lunchbuffet and dinner set meal (soup, maindish, dessert) , water, coffee and tea, Internet, kitegear storage,  rescues and help on the beach, yoga
</p></div><div id="cc-m-6880783618" class="j-module n j-gallery "><div id="cc-m-gallery-6880783618" class="cc-m-gallery-container            cc-m-gallery-slider                        cc-m-gallery-slider-fullscreen-enabled           ">

        <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column last" style="width: 49%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-1814662418"><div id="cc-m-7206894918" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7206894918">Glamping Pods</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7182328518" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
     
</p>

<p>
    Each glamping pod has all the amenities as in a bungalow, however you are in an actual 25 sqm hut with 360 degree view. Bathrooms are shared in a nearby showerhouse
</p>

<p style="text-align: center;">
     
</p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">
    single occupation: 55 Euro per person, double occupation: 40  Euro per person
</p>

<p>
    incl: Breakfastbuffet, lunchbuffet and dinner set meal (soup, maindish, dessert) , water, coffee and tea, Internet, kitegear storage,  rescues and help on the beach, yoga
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7182328218" class="j-module n j-gallery "><div id="cc-m-gallery-7182328218" class="cc-m-gallery-container            cc-m-gallery-slider                                  ">
